Definition

Measure of thermal energy stored in the upper ocean layers, used to assess cyclone potential and climate trends.

Operational example

Research vessel Triton to data buoy network: transmitting ocean heat content profile to 700 metres, grid point nine-two south, three-zero east, acknowledge receipt, over.
